content.text:
Fixed. Emphasis now survives in a reference link whose text holds another link, for `*`, `_`, `**`, and when the inner link is a reference link (example 533).

**Cause:** `Lexer.inlineTokens` hides every defined reference link from the emphasis scanner by blanking it out in `maskedSrc`. Then `Tokenizer.reflink` → `outputLink` rejects the outer link because its text contains a link (the CommonMark "no links inside links" rule). The rejection falls back to plain text, but the `*` delimiters were still hidden, so they never paired.

**Fix:**
- `src/Tokenizer.ts`: new `reflinkTextHasLink(src)`. It lexes the link text the same way `outputLink` does and reports whether a link is produced. Image links and text with no `[` return false straight away.
- `src/Lexer.ts`: the masking pass skips a defined reference link only when `reflinkTextHasLink` says it will be kept. A rejected link stays visible to emphasis, and an accepted one is masked as before.

I chose a check at masking time over changing the fallback, because an earlier delimiter outside the link (e.g. `*x [bar *baz [q](/y) r*][ref]`) also depends on the mask.

**Tests:**
- Example 533 was marked `shouldFail` in both `test/specs/commonmark/` and `test/specs/gfm/`. It passes now, so I removed that flag in both files.
- Added to the `link in link text` block in `test/unit/marked.test.js`: exact-output checks for the reported `*`, `_`, `**` and reference-link cases, plus a guard that emphasis inside an accepted reference link (with a code span holding `[y](z)`) is still hidden.

**Results:**
- `node esbuild.config.js` builds cleanly.
- `node --test test/run-spec-tests.js`: 1787/1787 pass.
- `node --test test/unit/marked.test.js`: 47/47 pass.
- The other unit files (`Lexer`, `Parser`, `Hooks`, `instance`, `bin`): 146/146 pass.

**Not run:** `tsc --noEmit` and `eslint`. Both commands were denied, so the TypeScript types and lint style of the two source edits are unchecked.

Nothing is committed.
